```{r}
getwd()
#library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
# To verify the readr library was loaded, run this code and look for "package:readr" in the console
# search()

# This is how you read what's on a .csv file.
read_csv(file = "testdata.csv")

# Modify column type in read_csv. The cols() function allows you to change the column type (eg. <dbl>, <chr>, <int>, etc.).
read_csv(
  file = "testdata.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    id = col_integer(),
    name = col_character(),
    age = col_integer(),
    food = col_character() )
  )

```
